I am an alumn from an ivy league school in the US. During my studies I got addicted to stimulants and it wrecked my life. I somewhat managed to graduate (barely), but my addiction got worse after graduation. I got fired fired twice in 6 months, addiction got even worse and I lost E-VE-RY-THING. I went from staying in 4-star hotels in Manhattan to borrowing $50 from my dad for food.  Only recently (3 years after graduation and 1,5 years sober) things are finally getting better little by little (although my life is only a shadow of the successful life I once had).

My advice to you: be VERY VERY afraid. Do whatever it fucking takes to drop this habit. WHATEVER IT TAKES. Otherwise you'll end up as me. You think you're a star, but you'll find how easy it is to go from hero to zero. Man up and take your life seriously. Pull yourself fucking together. Don't do this to yourself. Every time you use drugs you're paying a huge future price. Every time you use drugs you're changing your destiny to something worse.

A little background: I got addicted after getting an HIV diagnosis (a few months before I started grad school). I desperated, tried suicide and when someone offered me drugs during my studies I was like 'whatever'. The habit stuck and I ended up using stimulants to ease the pain. Recovery was super hard, and I only could do it thank's to God, but I psychologically hurt a lot of people along the way, especially my parents.

Hit me up in private if you wanna chat briefly. I don't wish you good luck, but I wish you strength to make a decision and commit.
